verdicts.reason: A has a sensible left-text/right-product split, but the SOLSTICE wordmark now sits below the headline and is almost as big as it, so the two compete. The headline also breaks with "fizz" alone on the second line, and the can is shrunk to a tiny afterthought on the right. B is worse. The CTA is jammed against the top edge, above the headline, so the reading order is reversed. The body line runs nearly edge to edge at a tiny size, and the small can floats over a large empty lower half, which leaves the layout top-heavy and lopsided.
